decisions.decision: Every credential is gated by the master password by default now (B7); the per-credential flag is inverted to `reprompt_exempt` (opt-out), backed by a NEW `reprompt_exempt` DB column rather than reinterpreting the old `reprompt` column's stored values
decisions.rationale: Reusing the old column under a flipped meaning would silently un-protect any credential a user had previously flagged true under the old opt-in semantics - a real security regression on existing vaults. A new column defaults to 0 (not exempt) for every row, old and new, which is the only migration that can't invert anyone's existing protection.

decisions.decision: Config's reprompt_mode renamed perCredential/global -> always/grace with a load-time migration in Config::load for the old spellings
decisions.rationale: The old "perCredential" mode (only flagged items ever prompt, no grace) has no meaning once every credential is gated by default - the toggle now only picks how the shared grace window behaves.

decisions.decision: JSON export/import (Wave 4 item 1) reuses CSV export's exact sealed envelope (portio::encode_sealed_csv) and added the decoder (decode_sealed_bytes) that format never had
decisions.rationale: portio.rs literally had a `// ponytail: no decoder; add one only if a future milestone needs to re-import this format` comment - this is that milestone. Reuse avoids inventing a second file format.

decisions.decision: JSON import is preview-then-commit but shows a COUNT SUMMARY (sites/credentials/duplicates), not CSV import's per-row editable table
decisions.rationale: An arbitrary nested export (sites -> credentials -> custom fields -> history) doesn't fit a flat editable table without much more UI work than this pass budgeted; the summary still shows the outcome before committing.

decisions.decision: JSON import merges by name (folders case-insensitively, sites exactly) and skips duplicate credentials (same site+username rule as CSV import); a single bad TOTP secret / malformed card hint / field-validation failure skips just that item instead of aborting the whole batch
decisions.rationale: Matches CSV import's own duplicate contract for consistency, and resilience to one bad record matters more than all-or-nothing correctness for a personal-vault-scale import.

decisions.decision: "Remember last username" (B5) and sidebar section collapse state (N18) are stored in localStorage, not the Rust-persisted vault config
decisions.rationale: Both are per-device UI conveniences involving no secret data (a username is already shown in plaintext on the Login screen), so a lighter-weight client-side store is proportionate and avoids touching the Config struct/migration for cosmetic state.

decisions.decision: Card brand and last-4 (N4-N6) are derived from the card number via a LOCAL IIN prefix table in src/lib/card.ts, never a network lookup, and both fields stay manually editable after the derivation
decisions.rationale: Matches the user's explicit "no network calls" constraint and "allow editing the auto-fetched value" instruction from earlier in the session.
